svg.title: Document intelligence: a branching chronology, 2007–2026
svg.desc: 62 representative models and methods, arranged around a descending S-shaped OCR/layout spine and three winding branches for document understanding, structured reasoning and retrieval. Yellow highlights indicate verified official weights. Branches organize coexisting research directions, not model ancestry.
svg.text: Coexisting research directions; branches do not imply ancestry.
